sloka: अचिरेणैव कालेन प्राप्स्याम्येव मनोरथम् ।दुष्प्रस्थानोऽयमाख्याति सर्वेषां वो विपर्ययः ।। ५.२४.२५।।।।
transliteration: acireṇaiva kālena prāpsyāmyeva manoratham ।duṣprasthāno'yamākhyāti sarveṣāṁ vo viparyayaḥ ।। 5.24.25।।।।

translations.english: 'Leave the helpless human Rama and seek Ravana's refuge. O Vaidehi, using the heavenly unguents and adorned with imposing ornaments from now on, be the queen of all people.
